steps.npc: Nilsal! Welcome to our camp, adventurer.

options.text: That sounds lovely, what tune is that?

steps.player: That sounds lovely, what tune is that?

steps.npc: Oh, this? It's just the beginning of something, still a lot more to come.
I s'pose the working title is...'The Doors of Dinh'.
We come from Varlamore... We're students of the College of Bards.
Or did you want to know where I'm from specifically? My home was destroyed long ago by an evil saltwater deity.

steps.player: Well, that's certainly a dark and tortured backstory. Say, have you slain any dragons? Wooed a beautiful princess? Sought revenge on the fiend who killed your family?

steps.npc: ...Dragons? Slain. Princesses? Wooed... but revenge, that's still brewing.
